title: PNP: No 'rescue, release' of Sara Duterte's ex-staff, 3 others

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) clarified that there was neither rescue nor release of two former staff members of Vice President Sara Duterte from a hotel in Taguig City last November 17, adding that the two were not being held against their will.
